Zenod 3 voice note.

Launch blockers need to be extracted into the backlog. We need clean-slate onboarding
so a new user can connect a vault and immediately understand the first run. The UX
should be two-phase: acknowledge ingestion immediately, then send a later digestion
report with evidence, meaning pages, and proposed work. Launch writing is still
needed, especially the public UX and docs review. The system should write backlog
records or GitHub issues, but proposed first unless we have a safe writer target.
